objective: Gate the NREL Phase VI blade forces that already exist on disk against the published low-speed-shaft torque in Hand et al. 2001, reported as a band over a stated averaging window rather than as a point, and rule on whether frozen-rotor MRF gets the mean right on a history it cannot settle
rationale: F8 is listed on the product list as MRF first, then transient. MRF first has already been run twice. The F8 phase6 MRF run directory holds a 230,135-cell UAE Phase VI Sequence S case at 7 m/s, checkMesh OK, taken to t=1500 on 2026-07-29 and restarted to t=3000 on 2026-07-30, and SIMPLE solution converged appears zero times in either log. The blade-force history widened rather than settled: Fx span 508 N over t=1500 to 2250 and 729 N over t=2250 to 3000, Fy swinging minus 775 to plus 1276 N against an original minus 336 to plus 280 N. More steady iterations demonstrably do not fix it and the campaign status already logs this as a genuine Group 3 convergence failure rather than glossing it. What has never been done is the comparison the case was built for. Hand, Simms, Fingersh, Jager, Cotrell, Schreck and Larwood 2001, NREL TP-500-29494, publishes low-speed-shaft torque and blade root bending moment against wind speed for the Sequence S test including the 7 m/s point this case is set at; the citation was found on 2026-07-29 and the tabulated data is not on disk. The measurement is a time average of an existing force history over a window declared before it is read, with its own spread, against that published torque. Prediction, written before the fetch: the mean will land within the oscillation half-width of the published torque, because the frozen-rotor limitation is a limitation on the history rather than on the mean loading, and the honest risk is the opposite, that a series which never settled has no meaningful mean at all. That risk is why the gate below fixes a maximum band width in advance.
gate: The averaging window and the maximum band width that still permits a comparison are both written down before the force history is read. Then: the window-mean of the low-speed-shaft torque derived from the existing bladeForces output, with its measured peak-to-peak spread, against the Hand et al. 2001 published value at 7 m/s. PASS if the published value lies inside our measured band AND the band is narrower than the pre-declared maximum. FAIL, reported as a result, if the published value lies outside. NO VERDICT, reported as such and not as a fail, if the band is wider than the pre-declared maximum, because a mean of a series that never settled is then not a measurement of anything
cost_basis: measured for the part that dominates and estimated for the rest. The force history is already written by the case's own blade-force function object and costs zero new compute to average; the 6 core-minutes price one short confirmation restart on the existing 230,135-cell decomposed case at 4 ranks, sized against the same case's own logged restart from t=1500 to t=3000. If the fetch of NREL TP-500-29494 fails, this item costs 0 and returns a blocked verdict rather than spending the 6
expected_knowledge_gain: The only external published reference this lab can reach from fields that already exist on disk. If the mean lands on the published torque, the finding is that frozen-rotor MRF captures the mean rotor loading on a case whose history it cannot represent, which is a clean and citable statement of a known MRF limitation and gives the transient case a target. If it does not, F8 carries a real bias and the transient work has a quantified gap to close. If the band is too wide to compare, that is itself the answer to whether steady MRF can gate this family at all, and it closes the MRF branch on evidence instead of leaving it open
citations: Hand, M.M., Simms, D.A., Fingersh, L.J., Jager, D.W., Cotrell, J.R., Schreck, S. and Larwood, S.M., Unsteady Aerodynamics Experiment Phase VI: Wind Tunnel Test Configurations and Available Data Campaigns, NREL TP-500-29494, 2001

launch_prompt: F8 NREL Phase VI, gate the forces that already exist. Do NOT start a new solve first. Read demo-output/website/campaign/NEXT_CASES_SLATE.md item 1 and the F8 section of campaign/CAMPAIGN_STATUS.md. Step 1, zero compute: write the pre-registration BEFORE reading any force number -- declare the averaging window over the existing history in F8_runs/phase6_mrf/postProcessing/bladeForces, and declare the maximum band width (as a percentage of the published torque) beyond which you will report NO VERDICT rather than a pass or a fail. Step 2: fetch NREL/TP-500-29494 (Hand et al. 2001) and extract the low-speed-shaft torque at the 7 m/s Sequence S point; if the tabulated value cannot be reached, stop and report BLOCKED at 0 core-min rather than substituting a secondary source without stating its provenance tier. Step 3: convert the existing bladeForces history to low-speed-shaft torque in the published quantity's own units and sign convention -- state the conversion explicitly, it is the step most likely to be wrong, and a torque that is off by the rotor radius or the blade count is the failure mode to guard against. Step 4: report the window mean, the peak-to-peak spread, and the verdict against the pre-declared band. Budget 6 core-min, 4 ranks, setsid, poll logs inline. Record: evidence file in demo-output/website/campaign/, docket update on this item, honest verdict -- a NO VERDICT with the band measured is a result and must not be dressed up as a fail or a pass.

outcome: NO VERDICT, reported as the result the gate defined for it. Pre-registered window t=2000-3000, cap 50% of the published torque; measured band 7678.7 N-m peak-to-peak = 960% of the 800 N-m reference (secondary tier: Processes 12(9):1994 Table 6, digitised from Hand et al. 2001; the docket's TP-500-29494 citation was a conflation -- that is Simms et al.'s blind-comparison report with figure-only torque, and Hand et al.'s TP-500-29955 publishes no torque table). Window mean |Mx| 1037.1 N-m (+29.6% vs reference) is void per the cap. Unconverged forces are not gateable; the steady-MRF branch closes on evidence. The budget's confirmation restart (5.8 of 6 core-min) found the mechanism lead: mean aero torque opposes the set rotation direction, and flipping omega calms the history 21x (p2p 132.8 vs 2831.6 N-m over t=300-600 on the identical mesh). Deliverable per the unconverged branch: the convergence-fix diagnosis plan in F8_MRF_HAND2001_GATE.md section 5.
